references.text: The original instruction regarding materials for the tabernacle, including red-dyed ram skins, badger skins, and acacia wood, which the people are now bringing as a freewill offering.
Describes the use of red-dyed ram skins and badger skins as a covering over the tabernacle.
The execution of the work to make the covering from red-dyed ram skins and badger skins for the tabernacle.
Acacia wood is used to build the ark of the covenant, which is one of its primary uses.
Acacia wood is used to make the boards for the tabernacle.
Acacia wood is used to build the altar of burnt offering.
Bezalel makes the ark of the covenant from acacia wood, fulfilling the instruction.
